episodes.title: Inside China’s robotics revolution
episodes.author: Chang Che
episodes.description: Chen Liang, the founder of Guchi Robotics, an automation company headquartered in Shanghai, is a tall, heavy-set man in his mid-40s with square-rimmed glasses. His everyday manner is calm and understated, but when he is in his element, up close with the technology he builds, or in business meetings…
